title: The Cargo trilogy
about: What spans the three games: the parts, the characters who live across them, and the promises one part makes for a later one to keep. Readable outline: TRILOGY.md. A part marked open is still being written, so what it owes is reported as pending.

parts.title: CARGO: Space Trading Saga
parts.status: 1.3: plays its story from story/ (built into cargo.py); keeps a captain's history across the parts and takes errands from later ones
parts.era: about 2420: the Hansa, the first legion, the first node

parts.title: Cargo 2
parts.status: 2.3 in the Cargo-2 repository, story in its story/cargo2/ (this folder's cargo2.story.json is the 2025 version's story, imported); keeps a captain's history and takes errands from Cargo 3
parts.era: about 40 years later: the Mandate, the Concord's houses and gates, the Binary Dawn

parts.title: Cargo 3
parts.status: 3.0.0-dev in the Cargo-3 repository: on foot as an able hand, act 1; gives errands to Cargo 1 and 2
parts.era: from about 2533, spanning several centuries of external time (relativistic legs): Project ERYX and the Gyrotron restart, up to the missions' departure

captain.name: The captain
captain.about: The player's captain. Carried between parts by the captain record. An earlier part shows a later part's captain as an older stranger: unnamed without a record, named from the record with one (the same person if the name matches, otherwise the captain the player went on to play).

timeline.as: the player; meets an older captain at an outpost (Cargo 2's) and past the portal (Cargo 3's); meets a clone
the player, about forty years on (less, with dilation); or an old NPC if the player starts a new captain
the player at the restart, or the name on a memorial

clone.name: The other captain
clone.about: Grown from the captain's customs scan by a research colony's insurer.

timeline.as: partner, rival or runaway
the other hauler with the captain's name

pirate_captain.name: Hedda Mraz
pirate_captain.about: Pirate with a count of grudges.

timeline.as: the vendetta
founder of the Void Angels free company, if spared

anselm.name: Anselm Rockwarden
anselm.about: Founder of the Rockwarden cooperative; grandfather of Maret Rockwarden (wiki canon).

timeline.as: the cooperative, Stonewright's first captain
a name on Stonewright's keel; Maret Rockwarden commands

ysolde.name: Yzode van Rostrom
ysolde.about: Founder of House Rostrom (wiki: CONZE Ysolde van Rostrom, Year of Foundation; renamed Yzode 2026-11-16, the wiki to follow).

timeline.as: junior researcher, then founder
head of House Rostrom, old and dilated

santor.name: Dharr Santor
santor.about: Flew the fourth Bekkenheim test and came back eleven minutes later with three weeks of beard.

timeline.as: test pilot
the name on the drive; possibly the man himself

ancient_scholar.name: Tylde Kren
ancient_scholar.about: Archaeophysicist; first to say the builders' metal was a ring around our own Sun.

timeline.as: the samples, the segment at Scholz's Star
old, still right (characters.yml has an 'ancient scholar' to rewrite)
her notes, or her upload

neurodroid_leader.name: CU-113
neurodroid_leader.title: Neurodroid Overseer
neurodroid_leader.about: Curator Unit 113, the first neurodroid to refuse an order; the game's Neurodroid Overseer. Machines do not age; they fork.

timeline.as: the captain's guild; the first node
a node of the Binary Dawn, remembering what the captain chose
unchanged, several times over

aela.name: Eela
aela.about: AEL-series boring agrobot; perhaps the first machine shareholder in the Hansa.

timeline.as: opens the Rockwardens' claim
still digging for Stonewright, if it was given a share

neon_sleeper.name: Conte Ottavine Kraal
neon_sleeper.about: A Neon who sleeps through decades and buys land before it is worth anything. Hibernation carries her across the saga.

timeline.as: sleeping cargo to Delta
awake again, thirty years on, asking for you
awake for the restart, barely older

heritarchist.name: Magister Notary Augias Pfennig
heritarchist.about: heritarchist to the {neon_family} family: reads family lines across hibernation cycles; bills for it

timeline.as: Conte Ottavine's heritarchist; reads the captain's family line and bills her for it
Astin Pfennig, his son or his clone, guards the waking fortune
a Pfennig still at the sarcophagus, by then nobody is sure which

serac.name: Serac
serac.about: a man from the inner systems who arranges things for Sol's defence contractors and the trading houses: dumping, recalls, fires; never in the room when they happen. Doesn't seem to age

timeline.as: behind the squeeze, the recall and the fire; one favour, then a commission
runs the Mandate's (TAM) operations and the Solar Union's inner-systems 'defence' wing
unchanged; still asks after the captain

meza_voce.name: Meza Voce
meza_voce.about: head of the Rootstock; a Concord nursery android written off at ten years, as they all are, with her voice set to half for sleeping children. She never turned it up. People lean in

timeline.as: runs food and biomass to Gamma's miners; remembers a double cross
the family has grown; she asks customs officers whether a certain captain is still flying

convoy_captain.name: Allsa Targa
convoy_captain.about: captain of a Hansa convoy who keeps score of every favour, both ways

timeline.as: captain of the Gamma-Alpha convoy; barges, a berth or a cold shoulder, an escort; comes to Alpha and to the vote
GRAB Targa, master of the Hansa's needle office, old and still counting

young_hauler.name: Pell Okafor
young_hauler.about: a hauler the captain met at nineteen, without a ship

timeline.as: nineteen, a fresh licence and no ship: friend, debtor or raider
fifty-nine, a Hansa senior who remembers who lent him a ship, or who turned him away

inspector.name: Hanne Lauritz
inspector.about: a customs inspector who writes everything down, bribes included

timeline.as: customs inspector; inspections, a sealed case, the notebook audit, the sting at Gamma
retired; her notebooks surface, with the captain's bribes in them, or the tea

the_seed.about: What the captain did when CU-113 refused order 4471. The Collective remembers.

the_stranger.about: Who the old hauler at the outpost was, and the pellet stamped with the captain's registry: a Hansa Mark from before there were any.

the_first_mark.about: The charter and the first Mark. Who signed first decides how the Hansa treats the captain.

the_fourth_test.about: Where Dharr Santor spent three weeks in eleven minutes: the first person displaced in time, and why the drive bears his name.

the_other_captain.about: The clone and what became of it.

the_heading.about: The course home from Scholz's Star, filed and unread for forty years. Cargo 2 opens the file; Cargo 3 flies it.

the_warning.about: 'Make sure it starts from home': the Gyrotron must be restarted from Sol, not from a faction's end of the ring.

the_stonewright.about: Stonewright comes back from the sublight run with Anselm's grandchild in command.

the_hollow_rock.about: What the nanobot colony at Sigma VII is building in the galleries.

the_lyra_rumour.about: The Maud Kettle's story and the magnetic chirps from Lyra: the first rumour of the Gordian moon, where ordinary electronics fail.

the_sleeper.about: Conte Ottavine wakes thirty years later and asks for the captain who carried her.

thirteenth_line.title: a name for the thirteenth line on level nine's plaque
thirteenth_line.about: In 2533 the plaque on level nine at Gamma has twelve names and a blank line 'for the hauler who brought the air'. In Cargo 1, after the captain helps get the miners out, {vent_boss} cuts the plaque and asks for the name. Back in 2533, the line has it, or stays blank.

vault_word.title: the word that opens the Kraal vault
vault_word.about: In 2533 {neon_sleeper} has slept too long in stasis and lost the word she chose for the family vault in 2460; the chambers take the newest memories first. In Cargo 2, newly awake at Delta, she chooses it and tells the captain. Back in 2533, the word opens the vault.

fixed_points.about: the older captain's warning at the portal happens: 'make sure it starts from home'
Scholz's Star took the segment from the ring 70,000 years ago
who restarted the Gyrotron is never shown; hints only
